retrievalProfile.description: A warm sepia-toned portrait featuring a male subject in aviators with large-scale, expressive hand-lettered text overlapping the left side.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in a white shirt and sunglasses, rendered in a monochromatic sepia palette, framed by a rough, hand-drawn black border and featuring prominent, fluid black ink lettering on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Text overlaps the subject's white shirt on the left third
Subject's gaze is directed away from the camera toward the right
The dark border contains the entire composition with irregular edges
High contrast between the dark ink lettering and the bright white shirt
coreInvariants: Fluid, connected script lettering with variable line weight

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark sunglasses and the large initial letters of the script.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large script on the left, move across the subject's chest to his face, and follow his gaze out of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left corner and the area around the subject's head provide breathing room for the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for text and borders
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the shirt highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the shirt and the ink.

letterConstructionRules: Variable pressure mimicking a felt-tip marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: Connected lowercase letters with high-reaching loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for all text elements to maintain a personal, signed feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, non-formal nature of the original lettering
Captures the personal, autographed quality of the layout

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned portrait of a man in aviator sunglasses and a white shirt, looking to the side, framed by a rough black hand-drawn border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large-scale, black hand-lettered script on the left side, allowing the letters to overlap the white shirt.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia, black, and white?
Does the text look like natural handwriting rather than a standard font?
Is the border irregular and hand-drawn in appearance?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the script relative to the subject

mustAchieve: Organic, tactile ink quality in the text
Intentional overlap between text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script is legible but expressive
Ensure the sepia tone is warm and not grey
Verify the border has a 'printed' or 'sketched' texture
Confirm the subject's gaze creates a sense of direction
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Portrait + Hand-Drawn Border + Overlapping Marker Script
